description: Disclose authorship on HEAD per ACO — the agent-native disclosure of work you just did. Pick the honest category: 'ai' (an AI authored it; you, the committer, are accountable) adds Authored-by-ai; 'with_ai' (a human authored it WITH AI assistance) adds Authored-by-human + Assisted-by; 'human' adds Authored-by-human. IMPORTANT: if the AI wrote the code and a human is merely committing it, that is 'ai' — do NOT claim 'with_ai'/human authorship the human didn't do. Amends HEAD's MESSAGE only (a testimony, never a content change) and refuses if there are staged changes. Evidence upgrade for the ai category (witnessed spans from a session log) is the CLI `madeby ai --witness`. Read the standard: madeby://guide/aco.

category.description: the honest authorship category (see the description). Defaults from with_ai if omitted.

model.description: the model version you are running as, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 — written as tool:model. Give it when the repo's AGENTS.md asks; omit it rather than guess.

path.description: path to the repo (default: the server's working directory)

print.description: return the disclosure trailer lines instead of amending HEAD — for platforms that make the commit themselves; put them in the commit message's last paragraph

tool.description: the AI tool to name (Assisted-by for with_ai, Authored-by-ai for ai). Default: AI.

with_ai.description: legacy shorthand: true ⇒ category with_ai, false ⇒ human. Prefer `category`.

name: disclose
